method.entry: shared 15m ORB/retest EMA9 + VWAP; next five-minute candle break; gap fill at worse open, no chase at target
method.exit: same-bar ties stop first; count ambiguous entry/stop as loss; EMA9 exit next open, max 60min or 11:30 ET
method.costs: 2 bps round trip underlying, stress 5 bps; not option returns or account equity
method.portfolio: at most one overlapping underlying position; SPY first on ties, reject a same-bar exit/re-entry
method.rearm: Neither arm has a count quota; after each exit require a full new 5m inside-range bar, fresh breakout/retest and trigger before that arm's own cutoff.
method.split_interpretation: Calendar holdout reused after the V1 results were seen; comparative, not a fresh untouched test.
method.volume: 09:30-09:45 vs trailing 20 XNYS sessions, median; minimum five complete openings
method.vix: exact previous XNYS daily close, modeled known at midnight ET after close; no intraday or same-day VIX
method.data: OpenD 5m RTH QFQ end labels minus 5m; Cboe daily VIX historical download; no archived as-published revisions
method.gex: unavailable: no archived time-matched complete chain + published open interest; never assign dealer sign
method.net_bps: fixed unit notional, additive non-compounded. No 0DTE greeks, NBBO, affordability, settlement or capital modeled.
method.only_difference: Last new-entry bar: 10:25 ET control, 11:10 ET extended. Both flatten by the 11:30 open.
method.paired: Extended minus same arm at 10:30 on every session, including flat days. 2,000 five-session moving-block bootstrap resamples. Same fixed seed at 2 and 5 bps round trip.
method.added: 10:30 through 11:10 entry starts only, even when a prior trade exits later; first/repeat determined by sequence within the extended arm. Bins have exclusive upper bounds.
method.scope: One additional cutoff, not parameter optimization. Previously inspected periods; intervals descriptive, not simultaneous or independent confirmation. SPY/QQQ only. No SPX, option chain or brokerage orders.
